entries.23195a436680c819: Its strengths are the glass material production technology it has maintained since its founding in 1935, and in-house production of optical glass materials. In addition to materials for optical products such as optical press products and optical block products, it also handles specialty glass for electronics, such as high-homogeneity optical glass for semiconductor exposure equipment, ultra-low expansion glass ceramics and quartz glass, and both businesses are based on glass material technology. As a new business, it has a product lineup of lithium-ion conductive glass ceramics 'LICGC' and is working to expand adoption by battery makers.
